div.head: Prom. Reg. Prol.
div.ab: Ðis gewrit is gewriten stǽf be stæfe be þam gewrite, þe Dunstan arcebisceop sealde urum hlaforde æt Cingestune, þa on dæg þa hine man halgode to cinge, ⁊ forbead him ælc wedd to syllanne, butan þysan wedde, þe he up on Cristes weofod léde, swa se bisceop him dihte:

Ðis gewrit is gewriten stǽf be stæfe be þam gewrite þe Dunstan arcebisceop sealde urum hlaforde æt Cingestune, þa on dæg þa hine man halgode to cinge, ⁊ forbead him ælc wedd to syllanne butan þysan wedde þe he up on Cristes weofod léde, swa se bisceop him dihte:

This document has been copied, letter by letter, from that which Archbishop Dunstan gave to our lord at Kingston, on the day when he was consecrated as king, forbidding him to give any pledge except this one which he laid upon Christ's altar, as the bishop directed him:

Folgender Urkundentext ist geschrieben Buchstaben für Buchstaben gemäss der Urkunde, welche Erzbischof Dunstan unserem Herrn zu Kingston an jenem Tage, als dieser zum König geweiht wurde, übergab, und [jener] verbot ihm, jegliches Versprechen abzugeben ausser folgendem Versprechen, das der [König], wie der Bischof ihm gebot, auf Christi Altar legte:

The following document is written letter for letter according to the document which Archbishop Dunstan gave to our lord at Kingston on that day when he was consecrated king, and [he] forbade him to give any pledge except the following pledge, which the [king], as the bishop instructed him, laid upon Christ's altar:
div.note: MS Cp (Cotton Cleopatra B XIII), headed ‘Promissio regis’; Liebermann dates it 975 or 978, 14 April. He prints the corresponding passages of the tenth-century coronation liturgy in Latin alongside (from p. 215), but there is no Latin for the prologue. Clause number standardised from ‘Sacr. cor. Prol.’ (Liebermann's siglum for this text is ‘Sacr. cor.’). K is the same MS (Cp) as column T.
